[**Working paper**]{.status-tag} · 2024

\[[medRxiv preprint](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.06.11.24308750v1)\]

> *We build Preston curves from regression models using regional data for 21 European countries divided into 506 regions. There is indeed a positive association between GDP per capita and life expectancy, with an upward shift in the curve over time. Yet the relationship differs between geographical areas.*
